_doc: Feature switches for build_from_md.py. Override per document in HEADERDATA: 'features: limit_bars=off, figures=on'. Override per run: PP_FEATURES=/path/to/file.json. Edit with assets/pp_features_dashboard.html.

limit_bars.label: Limit bars
limit_bars.help: [[LIMITS]] blocks: value + colour bar against its acceptance limit in each cell

limit_bars_legend.label: Limit bar legend
limit_bars_legend.help: Print the bilingual legend under a [[LIMITS]] table

limit_bars_amber_at.label: Amber threshold
limit_bars_amber_at.help: Fraction of the limit (bar length) above which a bar turns amber

figures.label: Figures
figures.help: [[FIGURE:path|width_mm]] places an image (chart, scan) in the document
